## How you checked it

- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check src tests`
- [ ] Web changes: `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, Playwright
- [ ] Docs, `.env.example` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated for visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private data in the diff
